text:
maria: proposing a 'mini cost pulse' widget for Console — quick glance for canary rollouts: token burn, cache-saved-tokens, per-model delta. small, update every 1m. thoughts?
kevin: love it. main constraint is sampling. we shouldn't compute token-level for 100% of traffic.
noah: agree. 1% sampling + deterministic upsample for canary routes? keeps stats stable.
jen: UX ask: show both absolute tokens and normalized metric (tokens/req) so variant comparisons are fair.
maria: how do we attribute cache savings? right now attribution is route-level, canaries cross routes.
kevin: idea: attribute by `session_id` + `chain_id` when available, otherwise fall back to route tag.
noah: telemetry needs model_variant tags (eg model:opt-13b-8bit) + quant tag or rollups will be wrong.
jen: also show quota impact: e.g. green band for quota slack, red when throttled. tiny sparklines for trend.
maria: internal API naming debate: should we return `cost_preview` on each invocation or emit a separate event?
kevin: prefer separate payload `econ_insight` so main response stays slim; SDKs can opt in.
noah: but routing uses cost hints for fallback decisions. adding another RPC might complicate latency paths.
jen: compromise: emit sidecar telemetry event with econ fields to pipeline; no change to client-facing API.
maria: agreed sidecar seems safer. for latency tradeoffs, want 'tokens_saved' vs 'ms_added' when using cache.
kevin: we can estimate ms delta using KV latency histograms + token delta. need per-request KV length metadata.
noah: pragmatic MVP: surface `cache_hit_rate_est` and `avg_tokens_saved` in the mini pulse, leave sim later.
cost-bot: SUMMARY: proposed telemetry schema econ.v1 with fields {model_variant, sampled_tokens, cache_hit, tokens_saved_est, tenant_id(opt), canary_flag}. ping @eng-telemetry for storage estimate.
kevin: prototype emitter sketch (example):
```json
{"schema":"econ.v1","model_variant":"opt-13b-8bit","sampled_tokens":124,"cache_hit":true,"tokens_saved_est":42}
```
jen: :thumbsup: can we prototype with 1h retention for the pulse index to keep storage tiny?
maria: action items: @kevin proto sidecar emitter, @noah add model_variant tags in router, @jen mock UI. checkin EOD Friday.
sre-bot: deploy note: sidecar emitter at 1% sampling ~+0.2 RPS per instance, will flag in deploy-probation.
kevin: got it, I'll post PR when ready.
noah: also: sampling bias for low-volume tenants — we should deterministic-sample or force-sample flagged canaries to avoid noise.
maria: good call. add deterministic sampling for tenants with <100req/day and force-sample for canaries.
jen: mock screenshots will go in #design later.
maria: thanks all — I'll convert notes into a short RFC after prototype.
